messages:
Priya: hey team, wrapping up my shift — quick handoff. primary -> Marcus, secondary -> Jordan. I'm leaving a few notes about open pages and the shadowing plan for Alina who starts shadowing tomorrow.

Marcus: ack, thanks Priya. i'm available now, switching pager to me. can you list active alerts and any mitigation steps you've taken?

Priya: sure. two running items: 1) increased 95th latency for text-gen-hosted in us-east-1 (sustained ~420ms vs target 220ms) since 05:10 UTC. 2) a customer-facing error rate spike for embeddings route (~5% errors for a single enterprise key) — looks like a rate limiter misconfig for that key.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-A (latency spike). Pager routed to @Marcus (primary), @Jordan (secondary). Severity: P2.

Priya: for latency I already scaled dedicated pool nodes (+2 gpus) and rolled a config change to reduce max_batch_size for that model; that brought p50 down but p95 still high. I also enabled prefix caching on the busiest route which gained ~30ms.

Marcus: good. any logs or runbook pointers?

Priya: runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/latency-investigation — check sections 2b and 4 (kernel selection and batching stats). Useful one-liner to pull recent tail latencies:

```bash
# recent p95 by model in last 30m
redwood-metrics query "p95_latency{service=\"text-gen-hosted\"}" --from=30m | jq .
```

Priya: for the embedding error I added an override on the rate-limiter to temporarily increase quota for that enterprise key (key-id: ent-4321) and notified the account team.

Jordan: thanks. Marcus — if latency persists we should consider failing over traffic to a slightly older quantized model variant until kernels catch up. that's in the runbook as fallback path C.

Marcus: yeah agree. Alina — for your shadowing tomorrow, you'll watch the first 20 minutes of the 08:00 UTC handover and then take the pager with me for the next 2 hours while i talk through the dashboards. i put a small checklist in the onboarding doc: https://redwood-internal/oncall/onboarding-shadowing.

Alina: sounds good — thanks. any specific dashboards i should open?

Priya: open these: Console -> Routes -> text-gen-hosted -> latency heatmap; Console -> Model Pools -> dedicated-us-east-1 -> instance stats; and Console -> RateLimiter -> key ent-4321 history. Also enable the token-level tracing toggle for a few sample requests.

DevBot: deployed config change redwood-rate-limiter@v3.2.1 to us-east-1 (who: Priya, sha: 7b9c1f).

Marcus: nice. timeline: i'll monitor for 30m. if p95 > 350ms after 30m we escalate to oncall runtime leads and open an incident call. Priya — any customer comms needed now?

Priya: I've DM'd the account team and legal for the embedding errors. For the latency issue, ops-postmortem channel is prepped but no public comms yet — waiting on stabilization.

Jordan: added a note to INC-2026-0421-A that fallback variant B is approved for emergency failover by runtime eng. If we trigger it, we should run a quick eval on top queries to check quality delta.

Marcus: copy. Alina, during your shadowing I'll show you how to trigger the fallback in the console (it's gated behind approvals) and how to rollback.

Alina: great — also i'll shadow the paging flow, want to make sure i know how to mute/forward correctly.

Priya: one more: coverage gap this weekend — saturday 00:00-06:00 UTC only has one oncall pro (we're still short a volunteer). i flagged growth for help but if no one signs up Marcus you'll be solo for some hours.

Marcus: noted. i can swap a block if someone volunteers. Jordan — can you share the low-latency checklist doc?

Jordan: sure: https://redwood-internal/docs/low-latency-checklist. short version: check kernel mismatches, model shard balance, batching distribution, and recent infra upgrades.

Priya: leaving diagnostics snippets in the incident thread: CPU/gpu heatmaps, recent deploy IDs, and the exact rate-limiter override command i used.

Marcus: thanks. i'll update thread with p95 numbers in 10m. Alina, feel free to ping me any time during shadowing if you want to take the pager briefly.

Alina: will do. one last quick question — what's the preferred way to document a handoff? i saw two patterns in past threads.

Priya: we use the handoff template in onboarding doc (section 3) — short bullets: current issues, mitigations applied, who to page next, and any pending follow-ups. paste it into the handoff thread and @mention the incoming. keeps things consistent.

Marcus: update: p95 now 310ms (down from 420). looks like the scaling + cache helped. i'll keep monitoring.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-0421-A status updated -> monitoring. next check-in in 30m.

Priya: awesome. handing off pager now to Marcus. good luck team :thumbsup:

Marcus: taking it. thanks Priya.

Alina: thanks Priya, Marcus, Jordan. excited to shadow tomorrow.

Jordan: gl — i'll be available as backup.

Marcus: closing handoff note.
